title: curve25519-dalek: Ed25519 Group Associativity & Ristretto255 Even-Point Characterization
description: Full-repository upstream cryptography snapshot from Beneficial-AI-Foundation/curve25519-dalek-lean-verify (commit 52cad87d, Lean v4.31.0, Apache-2.0). Closes two foundational elliptic-curve mathematics `sorry` obligations backing Rust's curve25519-dalek verification: Ed25519 twisted Edwards group-law associativity (`Edwards.add_assoc_Ed25519`, completing `AddCommGroup (Point Ed25519)`) and Ristretto255 even-point surjectivity onto the doubling image (`curve25519_dalek.ristretto.IsEven_iff_in_doubling_image_right`), verified against prebuilt sorry-free upstream `.olean` dependencies plus Mathlib, Aeneas, and PrimeCert.

tasks.title: Prove twisted Edwards group-law associativity on Ed25519 (`Edwards.add_assoc_Ed25519`)
tasks.description: Closes the sole remaining `sorry` in `Curve25519Dalek/Math/Edwards/Curve.lean:366-371` (`Edwards.add_assoc_Ed25519`): prove `p + q + r = p + (q + r)` for all `p q r : Point Ed25519` (completing `AddCommGroup (Point Ed25519)` without `sorryAx`) using standard axioms only. Accepted patches apply directly upstream to `Beneficial-AI-Foundation/curve25519-dalek-lean-verify@52cad87d`.

tasks.title: Prove every even Ed25519 point lies in the doubling image (`IsEven_iff_in_doubling_image_right`)
tasks.description: Closes `curve25519_dalek.ristretto.IsEven_iff_in_doubling_image_right` at `Curve25519Dalek/Math/Ristretto/Representation.lean:440-442`: prove `IsEven P → ∃ Q : Point Ed25519, P = Q + Q` for all `P : Point Ed25519` (building on the sorry-free `AddCommGroup (Point Ed25519)` from `add_assoc_ed25519`) using standard axioms only. Accepted patches apply directly upstream to `Beneficial-AI-Foundation/curve25519-dalek-lean-verify@52cad87d`.
